title: Kilian Paris Good Girl Gone Bad – Eau de Parfum for Women, 100 ml
short_description: A luxurious white floral fragrance with osmanthus, tuberose and a warm cedarwood base.
description:
Kilian Paris Good Girl Gone Bad is a luxurious white-floral Eau de Parfum for women. It opens with fruity-floral osmanthus, orange blossom and May rose, blooms into tuberose, jasmine and narcissus, and settles into a warm woody base of cedarwood and vetiver. Moderate to long-lasting with moderate sillage.

**Size:** 100 ml

**Concentration:** Eau de Parfum

**Best for:** daily wear, date nights, evenings and special occasions, especially in spring and summer.

details.title: How to use
details.body: Spray on pulse points – wrists, neck and behind the ears – from about 15 cm away. Do not rub. Store away from sunlight and heat.

details.title: Shipping and returns
details.body: Express shipping across India. Easy replacement if the product arrives damaged or incorrect.
